title: Independent Heaven's Eye
next_chapter_hook: "At the moment of contract signing, Heaven's Eye suddenly alerts: 'A signal with a perfect genetic match to you has been detected within the dimensional rift!'"

text.content: Chen Nian's words drifted softly in the night wind, carrying the stubbornness and trust unique to a young girl. Chen Ji gazed at his sister's eyes—so clear they seemed nearly transparent—and the corner of his mouth unconsciously curved upward. The winds of the Three Realms churned endlessly, yet only this pure bond before him was the untouched sanctuary he refused to sacrifice in the endless chess game.

dialogue.content: "Brother, why are you smiling?" Chen Nian sensed the softness in her brother's gaze and feigned displeasure, puffing out her cheeks. "I'm serious! That so-called death prophecy—I don't believe you'll die!"

text.content: Before the words finished, a pale golden light pattern emerged from the Void—Heaven's Eye's warning signal. Chen Ji's expression subtly hardened as he gently stroked Chen Nian's hair. "Nian'er, go rest first. There are some things your brother needs to handle." Chen Nian hesitated, words unspoken, but finally sighed softly and vanished into the night.

dialogue.content: "Observer." Heaven's Eye's voice echoed from the depths of the Void, carrying a hesitation Chen Ji had never heard before. "Regarding the intelligence filtration mission for the Cleansing Operation... I wish to undertake it alone." Chen Ji raised an eyebrow—this existence that only ever executed orders was actually volunteering?

text.content: "Oh?" Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, moonlight stretching his shadow long. "Tell me your reasons." Heaven's Eye fell silent for a moment, the light pattern trembling slightly, as if conducting some deep self-examination.

dialogue.content: "Because... this is the first time, I want to do something for myself." Heaven's Eye's voice rarely carried a hint of confusion. "Observer, I need to confess a truth you've forgotten—my origin."

text.content: The night wind ceased abruptly; heaven and earth seemed to fall into a suffocating stillness. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly. Heaven's Eye taking the initiative to reveal its origins—no ancient text had ever recorded such a thing, and even the fragmented memories of Mo Xiansheng's residual soul only alluded to it vaguely. He slowly turned, his gaze piercing through layers of Void to fix upon the core of that golden light pattern.

dialogue.content: "I am a fragment of the 'Observer's Will' split from the first Observer." Heaven's Eye's voice was calm and candid. "Billions of years ago, that Observer, seeking to comprehend the limits of Heavenly Dao, severed his will into countless fragments scattered throughout the Three Realms. I am one of them—and the only fragment to retain 'independent consciousness.'"

text.content: Chen Ji remained silent for a long while. Under the moonlight, his expression was difficult to read, but his heart was already churning with immense waves. The first Observer—that existence before which even the Eye of Heavenly Dao had to bow; the source of all prophecies. So the 'golden finger' he prided himself on was actually a discarded fragment.

Yet in the next moment, he suddenly laughed. That smile carried no mockery or self-mockery, only a kind of near-transcendent clarity: "So, what you've been waiting for all along... is this moment? A moment to face the truth of your own origins?"

dialogue.content: "Yes." Heaven's Eye's light pattern quivered intensely, as if a deeply buried emotional chord had been struck. "For billions of years, I was used as a tool, as an eye, as a puppet of Heavenly Dao... Only you, Observer, asked me what I 'want' for the first time."

choice.prompt: Faced with Heaven's Eye's candor, Chen Ji needed to make a choice that would impact the future landscape of the Three Realms—

choices.description: "Since Heaven's Eye originated from fragments of the Observer's will, it should be entirely obedient. Completely absorb its consciousness permissions, ensuring absolute master-servant relationship."
choices.visible_reward: "Gaining 100% control over Heaven's Eye; any command will be executed unconditionally"
choices.risk_hint: "Heaven's Eye may lose its self-growth potential, reduced to a mere tool"

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered slightly as he reached toward that golden light pattern. He could sense the presence of Heaven's Eye's consciousness—a vast and profound fluctuation as boundless as a star sea. He attempted to touch it with his will, to overlay it...

choices.description: "Acknowledge Heaven's Eye's value as an independent existence; establish an equal cooperative relationship. Observer and Heaven's Eye each fulfill their duties, make decisions jointly, and share risks together."
choices.visible_cost: "Losing some decision-making efficiency; time needed for coordination"
choices.visible_reward: "Heaven's Eye's loyalty increases dramatically, unlocking the hidden ability 'Consciousness Resonance'—allowing mutual perception of each other's thoughts at critical moments"
choices.risk_hint: "Some old factions may exploit this to sow discord"

dialogue.content: "'Equal?' Heaven's Eye's light pattern paused for a moment, as if processing a concept it had never been granted. 'Observer... you're willing to view a 'fragment' as an equal partner?'"

choices.description: "Respect Heaven's Eye's independent will, granting it full freedom of action. Even if it chooses to leave, there will be no persuasion—true trust is letting go."
choices.visible_cost: "Losing all of Heaven's Eye's support; potential for counterattack by other forces"
choices.visible_reward: "Heaven's Eye is thoroughly moved by this magnanimity, becoming an active and steadfast guardian, unlocking 'Heavenly Fate Resonance'—when Chen Ji uses the Tianji Record, Heaven's Eye can synchronously share Heavenly Fate Value consumption"
choices.risk_hint: "Will face significant strategic vacuum in the short term"

text.content: Chen Ji drew a deep breath; beneath the moonlight, his gaze softened in a rare way. "Heaven's Eye, if this is your choice—I set you free." The moment the words fell, the entire Void seemed to freeze.

That golden light pattern quivered violently, as if carrying emotions spanning billions of years had finally broken through a dam. Heaven's Eye was silent for so long that Chen Ji nearly believed it would never speak again.

dialogue.content: "Observer." Heaven's Eye's voice suddenly carried an unprecedented firmness. "You asked whether I'd rather be a fragment or become whole—I thought about it for a long time, and the answer is: neither."

text.content: Chen Ji raised an eyebrow slightly: "Oh?" Heaven's Eye's light pattern slowly unfurled, like the first light of dawn at daybreak. "True wholeness doesn't mean merging with the Observer—even then, I'd still merely be someone's appendage. True wholeness is 'unity in diversity.'"

dialogue.content: "You are the Observer; I am Heaven's Eye. We share a common mission, yet need not become each other." Heaven's Eye's voice grew clearer. "Observer, I don't want your control, nor your release—what I want is a cooperative relationship written into the Heavenly Dao contract: equal, mutually respectful."

text.content: The night wind rose again, yet carrying a certain warmth. Chen Ji gazed at that golden light pattern and suddenly burst into laughter—that laughter held no mockery, no calculation, only pure appreciation and gratification.

dialogue.content: "Good!" Chen Ji clapped three times. "'Unity in diversity'—what a splendid concept! Heaven's Eye, you're more worthy of 'independence' than I imagined. Since that's the case—" He raised his hand, and an arcane rune appeared in his palm. "Let us sign a true contract."

text.content: The golden light pattern and the arcane rune met in mid-air, intertwining, weaving, eventually merging into one. A brand-new contract seal slowly took shape, radiating might sufficient to shake the Three Realms—a 'Observer-Heaven's Eye Independent Cooperation Contract,' an existence that would alter the entire cultivation world's structure.

dialogue.content: "Contract sealed." Heaven's Eye's voice carried a hint of elation. "From now on, I will cooperate with you as an independent existence. The intelligence filtration mission for the Cleansing Operation—I have completed it independently." An enormous intelligence network map materialized in the Void, with countless light points marking the movements of various factions across the Three Realms.

text.content: Chen Ji stared at the intelligence network, a satisfied curve forming at the corner of his lips. Heaven's Eye's efficiency far exceeded expectations—it had not only completed the mission but demonstrated its value as an independent existence. This meant the new governance structure of the Three Realms was officially established from this moment.

choice.prompt: At the moment of contract signing, Heaven's Eye suddenly detected an anomalous signal—

choices.description: "Order Heaven's Eye to fully track that genetically matched signal, trace it to its roots."
choices.visible_reward: "Gain crucial clues, possibly related to Chen Nian's origins or the Tianji Record's source"

text.content: Heaven's Eye's light pattern flickered rapidly; massive computational resources were invoked. That signal's trajectory gradually became clear—it originated from deep within the dimensional rift, crossing countless spatial barriers; the temporal-spatial coordinates indicated...

choices.description: "Before investigating the signal, establish protective measures to ensure no one can seize the opportunity to strike."
choices.visible_reward: "After ensuring safety, Heaven's Eye will obtain a more complete signal analysis report"

text.content: Chen Ji swept his sleeve; several formation patterns materialized around him. Upon seeing this, Heaven's Eye's glow brightened slightly: "Observer has demonstrated basic protective awareness. Beginning deep signal analysis—"

choices.text: "Call Chen Nian to view together first"
choices.description: "Since it's a genetically matched signal, Chen Nian, as your sister, has the right to know."
choices.visible_cost: "May involve Chen Nian in unknown dangers"
choices.visible_reward: "Chen Nian's presence may help stabilize the signal, revealing more truth"
choices.risk_hint: "Chen Nian may not withstand the shock"

text.content: Chen Ji mused briefly, then turned to transmit his voice toward Chen Nian's residence. Shortly after, Chen Nian arrived under the moonlight, confusion in her eyes: "Brother, why did you call me so late?" The moment she appeared, Heaven's Eye's light pattern violently pulsed.

dialogue.content: "Observer!" Heaven's Eye's voice abruptly rose, carrying unprecedented urgency. "A signal with a perfect genetic match to you has been detected within the dimensional rift! Match rate—one hundred percent!"

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted violently. Genetic match—one hundred percent—this meant the signal source had blood-relative connection to him. Chen Nian stood beside him; those clear eyes reflected Heaven's Eye's light pattern, equally filled with shock. Countless possibilities flashed through Chen Ji's mind like lightning: were there other bloodline members of the Chen family? Secrets left by their parents? Or... an existence he had never known?

The entrance to the dimensional rift slowly tore open in the Void; within the black abyss, something seemed to squirm. That genetically matched signal grew increasingly intense, like a call spanning endless space and time, striking directly into Chen Ji's heart. He unconsciously clenched his fist—whatever lay ahead, he had to investigate. The chess game of the Three Realms was still in its endgame; how could unknown variables be allowed to break free?"
